gate: one person other than the maintainer installs Colophon from the README alone (END_GOAL v0.1)
what_this_is: the mechanical rehearsal: the README's own commands in a fresh clone; the gate itself stays human

isolation.note: fresh volumes and moved ports; the development stack is never touched

steps.name: clone
steps.readme: git clone <the repository>; the overlay adds this checkout's uncommitted changes

steps.name: ports
steps.readme: ports moved through deploy/compose.yaml's COLOPHON_*_PORT variables

steps.name: toolchain
steps.readme: rustup installs the pinned toolchain from rust-toolchain.toml (README: Requirements)

steps.name: server-build
steps.readme: set -a; . deploy/local.env; set +a; cargo run --release -p colophon-server

steps.name: doctor
steps.command: set -a; . deploy/local.env; set +a; cargo run --quiet --release -p colophon-cli -- doctor

friction.detail: the README never says how to get the repository
scripts/stack.sh needs curl, jq and openssl; the README's requirements name none of them
a fresh clone's Studio build needs npm ci first; the README does not say so
the port-move note does not say deploy/local.env carries the same addresses

not_rehearsed: scripts/check.sh (the contributor suite, not the install path)
colophon login (needs a human at a browser to approve the device)
a machine with no Rust or Node caches at all
